تقتتلن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَتِلْنَ (taqtatilna) /taq.ta.til.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# تُقْتَتَلْنَ (tuqtatalna) /tuq.ta.tal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
